findings.text: the same 53-pass figure is anchored to two different heads across the node's own artifacts: the evidence section and the plan landing comment cite '46 passing cases at base 3332b9d to 53 at a30af4f8', while the node's own after_suite observation and final.log record the suite revision as d7a7dc5. Independently re-ran the gate at both heads and got 53 at each (docs commit d7a7dc5 does not touch test files), so the figure is correct under either reading; the cited and logged heads simply disagree, which is an internal bookkeeping inconsistency in the record rather than a wrong measurement.

justifications.durability: running the final tests/test_manifest_parse_format.py against the base source fails the three literal-text cases (3 failed, 50 passed), so those tests pin the fix and the safe-form/control cases pin the unchanged behaviours.
justifications.evidence: independently materialised base 3332b9d (46 passed) and final d7a7dc5 (53 passed) via git archive and re-ran tests/test_manifest_parse_format.py from each tree, matching the node's baseline.log/final.log, and re-derived the reproduction pair that the 3 corrupt spellings decode to numbers at base and literals at final.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/reports.py:561 reuses the extracted _split_bracketed_list helper so _decode_bracketed_list and _coerce_commit_identifiers share one splitting rule, and the new names are mechanism-descriptive with no banned labels; docked one for the record-internal head-citation inconsistency above.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/reports.py:414 routes only the commits field through _coerce_commit_identifiers, which parses a bracketed string via _split_bracketed_list so [29937e892], [29937e8] and [1e5] each keep their literal text instead of inf or a float.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff 3332b9d..d7a7dc5 --name-only lists exactly the four declared write paths (reckon/crew/reports.py, tests/test_manifest_parse_format.py, docs/evidence/archive/crew-observability-truth-landed.html, docs/plans/crew-observability-truth.html) and nothing else.
